digest.component_or_area: metrics analyzer toolchain and development environment bootstrap
propositions: The metrics extra (lizard, scc, jscpd) is already transitively installed by the dev extra but this intent is not explicit in the bootstrap targets, creating a maintenance risk if the self-reference is trimmed
Makefile install and install-unlocked targets must explicitly name the metrics extra to pin the dev-environment intent independently of CI-testing rationale
The two non-Python analyzers (scc and jscpd) cannot be installed via Python extras and require documented OS-level installation steps using brew and npm
docs/local-dev-env.md must document scc and jscpd installation as optional with graceful degradation to Unavailable status rather than hard failure when absent
